name: Sorcerer Slayer
source:
The story of Sorcerer Slayer begins with the death of the protagonist's father. Due to their strained relationship, he decides to skip the funeral, but soon a mysterious woman appears. Her revelations turn the hero's life upside down: a professional mage-killer suddenly discovers magical powers of his own.

[From [url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/sorcerer-slayer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《魔法杀手》的故事是从主角父亲的去世开始的。由于他们的关系紧张，他决定跳过葬礼，但很快一名神秘女子出现了。她的揭露使英雄的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化：一名职业法师杀手突然发现了自己的魔法力量。

[来自[url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/sorcerer-slayer]itch.io[/url]]
